content.notes: REQ-1.1 (fixture public_homepage) only asserts page.goto('/') then expectHomePage: both visible texts /take a note/i and /search/i, plus the home page must render without JS errors. No API call is required for this node, so / is a static SPA route; data endpoints (GET /api/notes etc.) belong to dependent nodes. The two matchers are text-only (getByText), so 'Take a note...' and 'Search' must be visible text on load. For downstream REQ-2.x/3.x/5.x/6.x tests that also openHome and require openSidebar to be a no-op when /notes/i is visible, the sidebar should already be expanded by default and contain Notes text; the Main menu toggle reopens it after collapse (REQ-6.2). Public tests are authoritative; any conflict between this design and the fixtures must be reported rather than silently dropped.

content.notes: REQ-2.1 (fixture notes_overview) is read-only: openHome then expectTextsVisible('Sprint goals','Groceries') and expectTextsVisible(/pinned/i, /others|notes/i). Reuse the existing GET /api/notes route; the home page must fetch it on load and render two separated sections headed 'Pinned' and 'Others'. Seed data: for a NEW store (and the checked-in backend/data/db.json) initialize exactly the two required records — 'Sprint goals' (pinned:true) and 'Groceries' (pinned:false) — per UI_CONTRACT_DATA (initialize required records only for a new store; never overwrite existing user data). Both titles must be visible text on /; use actual heading elements for 'Pinned' and 'Others' so /pinned/i and /others/i match. Keep every REQ-1.1 element (Take a note..., Search, Main menu, Settings, List view) intact and the sidebar Notes label visible so openSidebar stays a no-op. Downstream nodes (REQ-2.2 create, REQ-2.8 pin) will render note cards in the notes-area; design the sections so note titles remain individually reachable by getByText/getByRole. Public tests are authoritative; report any conflict with the fixtures instead of silently dropping requirements.
